footer.about: AXA is a team that helps international visitors experience medical care and travel in Daegu more easily and safely.
footer.service: MediDaegu is a medical tourism information platform that uses public data and AI to provide hospital and procedure information, as well as visa and travel information, in multiple languages.
footer.disclaimer: This platform provides information based on public data and does not recommend specific hospitals or provide medical consultation. Please confirm treatments, procedures and reservations directly with the hospital.
footer.source: Data: Health Insurance Review & Assessment Service (HIRA) hospital information APIs, via data.go.kr

hospital.hoursNote: Hours may change. Please call the hospital before you visit.

prices.notice: Amounts shown are market price ranges. Actual costs vary by hospital and treatment, and procedures offered differ by hospital. This is not advertising, a recommendation, or medical advice. You can ask a hospital for a written cost estimate.
prices.fxNotice: Converted amounts are for reference only. Actual costs are in Korean won as quoted by the hospital. Rates applied on {{applied}} (Bank of Korea, as of {{base}}; updated daily at {{hour}}:00 KST) ·
prices.fxFallback: Could not load exchange rates, so prices are shown in Korean won.

bot.askDept: Which department are you looking for?
bot.askRegion:
Which area should we look in?
Pick an area and I'll show hospital information and official contact channels.
bot.hospitals: In Hospital Info you can see matching hospitals sorted by distance or name. Please check each hospital’s official contacts and opening hours.
bot.price: You can see price ranges by treatment in the Price Guide. Actual costs vary, so please confirm with the hospital.
bot.interpret: Interpreter support varies by hospital. Please check supported languages through the hospital’s official contact before visiting. For travel interpretation, you can call the 1330 Korea Travel Hotline.
bot.tour: Daegu travel information is coming soon. Avoid a heavy schedule right after treatment, and check recovery advice with your hospital.
bot.emergency: This may be an emergency. Call 119 now or go to the nearest emergency room. 119 offers foreign-language interpretation.
bot.fallback: This is a demo and AI chat isn't connected yet. Please pick a topic below.

chat.disclaimer: AI answers are for information only. Please confirm treatment and bookings with the hospital.
